name: Periphery-Free and Cover-Recursive Peripheral Classes Are Disjoint
scope: Finite partial cubes; the periphery-free side contains only nontrivial objects.
statement: No nontrivial periphery-free partial cube is cover-recursive peripheral; consequently neither class contains the other.
proof: Every nontrivial cover-recursive peripheral class has a peripheral coordinate at the root of its recursive construction, so the two classes are disjoint. The six-cycle is periphery-free, while the square is cover-recursive peripheral and not periphery-free.
